snippet.title: Fable - Gameplay Overview | Xbox Developer Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the best look yet at Playground Games' Fable from Xbox's latest Developer_Direct, which also included the big reveal that the much-anticipated game will be released on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, and PC in Autumn 2026. In this deep dive, see how you will grow from a kid to the first hero Albion has seen in a generation. Following a mysterious stranger turning your grandmother and others into stone, you'll embark on a journey that will be defined by you. And yes, your journey will take you to Bowerstone, put you face-to-face with new and familiar enemies like the giant fire-breathing chicken known as a Cockatrice, and making choices that will change this land, and the people's view of you, forever. 

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
